CustomField.description: This field can be either set to 2 or 3 (empty means it's set to 2). It controls the scale of the percent fields in contract discounts, promo and price waterfall. The fields are set to 3 decimal places in their configurations, but are displayed based on this setting in negOptim custom pages, such as conditions manager, negotiate, duplicate contract, price waterfall and commercial plan simulation.
CustomField.label: Discount Percent Scale
